'''Skeleton Mages''' are monsters found in [[Piscatoris Fishing Colony]]. They primarily use [[Magic]] to attack. They play a role in the [[Swan Song]] quest, where the player creates an army of them to help defeat the [[sea troll]]s. Level 49 mages cast fire spells, and will sometimes use the [[Vulnerability]] spell on a player.

==Trivia==
* Skeleton mages can perform the [[Zombie Dance]] and [[Zombie Walk]] emotes, even though they are skeletons.
* If players try to open a pot of [[bone seeds]] too close to [[Malignius Mortifer]], he will say, "You should take that pot further away from me before you open it!"
